title: Go-Live Checklist
description: Final pre-launch checks before pointing DNS and handing a site to the client.

steps.title: Remove Staging Barriers
steps.instructions: Disable maintenance mode, HTTP basic auth, noindex plugins, and any 'coming soon' landing pages.

steps.title: Allow Search Engine Indexing
steps.instructions: Uncheck 'Discourage search engines from indexing this site' under Settings → Reading on production.

steps.title: Test All Forms
steps.instructions: Submit every contact, quote, newsletter, and checkout form. Confirm notifications arrive and CRM/webhook integrations fire.

steps.title: Confirm Analytics & Pixels
steps.instructions: Verify GA4, Meta Pixel, or other tags fire in Tag Assistant or browser devtools on key conversion pages.

steps.title: Check Favicon & Social Previews
steps.instructions: Confirm site icon, Open Graph image, and Twitter card metadata render correctly when sharing homepage and a sample post.

steps.title: Publish Legal Pages
steps.instructions: Ensure Privacy Policy, Terms, and cookie notice pages exist, are linked in the footer, and match the client's jurisdiction.

steps.title: Submit Sitemap to Search Console
steps.instructions: Confirm robots.txt allows crawling, XML sitemap is reachable, and submit the property + sitemap in Google Search Console.

steps.title: Create Client Admin Account
steps.instructions: Provision the client's administrator account, document login URL, and remove temporary agency-only credentials where appropriate.
